integrity: A symbolic graph/spectral proof and standalone exact-integer verification are supplied; computational checks through selected finite alphabet sizes are not substituted for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for a labeled alphabet, oriented cyclic length-four factors with one adjacent doubled symbol and exactly three distinct symbols; rotation only is identified. It does not count reversal or alphabet relabeling classes. Possible equivalent non-backtracking Euler-tour enumerations outside inspected literature remain a novelty risk.
title: Exact universal-cycle count for adjacent-double four-letter words
